lines.text: Syuen.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm busy.
You think you're so good at pushing people around?
Meet me up on the surface.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Have you lost your mind?

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Is this {AccountData.NickName}?
Yes.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Don't move.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'm coming to where you are. I'm going to set you straight.
Article 4 Section 1 of the Ark's law states that CEOs of the Big Three must remain abreast of the situation up on the surface.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What are you babbling about?
Meet me at the elevator to go for a grand tour of the surface.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: What's this all about?
For a while, there's no further response from Syuen.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Is this for real?
Wait, is she actually going to...

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: Anytime we report up to the surface, we have to be escorted by one commander and a squadron.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: You obviously can be the commander.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll leave formulating the squadron to you as well.
Okay.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: The law also stipulates that we have to be armed.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll bring my own weapon.

lines.speaker: syuen
lines.text: I'll be waiting for you in front of the elevator.
